name: t
description: simulation time

name: omega_ref
description: driver/cycle speed request

name: iq_ref
description: speed loop -> q-current request (after current clip)

name: omega_m
description: mechanical speed

name: omega_el
description: electrical speed = p * omega_m

name: epsilon_el
description: electrical rotor angle

name: i_d
description: d-axis current

name: i_q
description: q-axis current

name: i_a
description: phase a current

name: i_b
description: phase b current

name: i_c
description: phase c current

name: u_a
description: phase a voltage (plant, measured)

name: u_b
description: phase b voltage

name: u_c
description: phase c voltage

name: T_elec
description: electromagnetic torque (plant-reported)

name: V_dc
description: DC-link (bus) voltage, true value; sets the inverter ceiling V_dc/sqrt(3)

name: V_oc
description: pack open-circuit voltage from SOC

name: V_rc
description: pack RC-branch (diffusion) voltage

name: V_term
description: pack terminal voltage

name: soc
description: state of charge

name: T_batt
description: pack temperature

name: R0_eff
description: pack ohmic resistance now (temperature and fault dependent)

name: i_batt
description: pack current (+ = discharging); this is what the battery DELIVERS

name: i_batt_max
description: BMS discharge-current limit in force (drops in a derate)

name: bms_limited
description: flag: BMS current limit is holding the pack back

name: i_dc
description: inverter DC current; this is what the motor side REQUESTS from the bus

name: P_el
description: electrical power into the motor (from delivered voltage and current)

name: P_inv_loss
description: inverter loss (idle + conduction, assumed)

name: P_dc
description: power drawn from the DC link = P_el + inverter loss

name: P_bms_clip
description: power burned in the BMS current limiter

name: bus_sag
description: M9: V_dc minus open-circuit voltage: total voltage the pack path loses

name: ceiling_loss
description: M9b: inverter ceiling now minus nominal ceiling (173.2 V); how much headroom the bus took away

name: d_i_dc
description: M10: pack current delivered minus inverter current requested (negative = bus starved, capacitor drains)

name: E_bus_unserved
description: M10b: cumulative energy the inverter wanted that the pack did not supply

name: P_chem
description: chemical power V_oc * i_batt

name: P_batt_loss
description: pack + busbar loss: RC branch, R0 and Rc heating

name: P_bus_store
description: power into (+) or out of (-) the DC-link capacitor C V dV/dt

name: resid_chain
description: chem - losses - bus - BMS clip: pack energy books, should be ~0

name: resid_bus
description: V_dc*(i_batt - i_dc) - C V dV/dt: DC-link current balance, should be ~0

name: lam_d
description: d flux linkage Ld*i_d + psi

name: lam_q
description: q flux linkage Lq*i_q

name: bemf
description: back-EMF magnitude w_el*psi: the voltage the motor 'spends' just spinning

name: v_demand_mag
description: |u_cmd|: voltage the controller wants

name: v_headroom
description: u_limit - |u_cmd|: negative = demand exceeds supply

name: u_d_cmd
description: REQUESTED d voltage

name: u_q_cmd
description: REQUESTED q voltage

name: u_d_app
description: DELIVERED d voltage (after our saturation)

name: u_q_app
description: DELIVERED q voltage

name: duty_peak
description: largest inverter leg duty (|1| = leg railed)

name: T_cmd
description: torque implied by the current request

name: f_id
description: f(x) for i_d

name: f_iq
description: f(x) for i_q

name: f_w
description: f(x) for omega (torque minus friction)

name: ts_f1
description: two-state drift f1(x) for omega: -T_fric/J (friction + drag, no i_d, no road load)

name: ts_g1
description: two-state input gain g1 = 1.5 p psi / J (torque constant over inertia; constant)

name: ts_d1
description: two-state lumped disturbance on omega: (-T_dist + 1.5 p (Ld-Lq) i_d i_q)/J = road load + reluctance term

name: ts_f2
description: two-state drift f2(x) for i_q with i_d = 0: (-R i_q - p omega_m psi)/Lq

name: ts_g2
description: two-state input gain g2 = 1/Lq (constant)

name: ts_d2
description: two-state lumped disturbance on i_q: (du_q - omega_el Ld i_d)/Lq = actuator mismatch + d-axis cross-coupling

name: ts_d1_red
description: part of ts_d1 that exists only because i_d is not 0 (reluctance torque / J): the size of the two-state reduction

name: ts_d2_red
description: part of ts_d2 that exists only because i_d is not 0 (-omega_el Ld i_d / Lq)

name: ts_z1
description: first tracking error z1 = omega_m - omega_ref (velocity)

name: ts_z2
description: second tracking error z2 = i_q - iq_ref, current minus its virtual control, using the TRUE current (the controller's e_q uses the MEASURED current: ts_z2 = e_q - gap_i_q in firewalled runs)

name: ts_res_w
description: measured d omega/dt minus (f1 + g1 i_q + d1); must equal resid_w (valid at log step <= 0.4 ms)

name: ts_res_iq
description: forward-difference d i_q/dt minus (f2 + g2 u_q_delivered + d2 - du_q/Lq) with u_q_delivered the same-row voltage; equals resid_iq

name: g_id
description: g for i_d = 1/Ld

name: g_iq
description: g for i_q = 1/Lq

name: d_id
description: actuator-mismatch disturbance on i_d = du_d/Ld

name: d_iq
description: actuator-mismatch disturbance on i_q = du_q/Lq

name: d_w
description: external road-load disturbance = -T_dist/J

name: d_w_fric
description: friction/drag acceleration = -T_fric/J (inside f, shown for analysis)

name: T_fric
description: friction + drag torque

name: T_dist
description: injected road/grade torque (positive opposes motion)

name: resid_id
description: measured di_d/dt minus model(f+g u_app): should be small

name: resid_iq
description: measured di_q/dt minus model

name: resid_w
description: measured dw/dt minus model

name: d_u_d
description: M2: delivered - requested, d axis

name: d_u_q
description: M2: delivered - requested, q axis

name: d_u_norm
description: M2 normalised: |du| / limit

name: u_limit
description: available voltage ceiling at this instant

name: saturated
description: flag: actuator saturated this step

name: d_u_plant_d
description: M3: plant-reported minus ours (hidden clipping), expect 0

name: d_u_plant_q
description: M3 q axis

name: i_ref_clip
description: M4: delivered - requested current reference

name: d_T
description: M5: actual torque - torque the current request implied

name: e_speed
description: M1: speed request - actual speed (what the driver did not get)

name: P_req_elec
description: electrical power requested: 1.5 (u_d_cmd i_d + u_q_cmd i_q)

name: P_del_elec
description: electrical power delivered: 1.5 (u_d_app i_d + u_q_app i_q)

name: dP_elec
description: M6: delivered - requested electrical power

name: P_mech_req
description: shaft power the current request implied: T_cmd * omega_m

name: dP_mech
description: M6b: delivered - requested shaft power (the physically clean mismatch)

name: E_mech_unserved
description: M8b: cumulative shaft energy requested but not delivered (preferred, always interpretable)

name: P_cu
description: copper loss 1.5 R (i_d^2 + i_q^2)

name: P_mag
description: rate of change of magnetic energy

name: P_mech
description: shaft power T_elec * omega_m

name: P_load
description: power into friction + road disturbance

name: P_kin
description: rate of change of kinetic energy J w dw/dt

name: P_balance_resid
description: P_del_elec - P_cu - P_mag - P_mech: should be ~0

name: E_req
description: cumulative requested electrical energy

name: E_del
description: cumulative delivered electrical energy

name: E_unserved
description: M8: cumulative requested minus delivered (the missing energy)

name: E_cu
description: cumulative copper loss

name: dist_i_limit
description: distance to current limit (1 = far, 0 = at limit)

name: P_req_ref
description: reference-implied ELECTRICAL power: 1.5 R iq*^2 + T_cmd w_m. Real power; depends only on the request and speed, never on delivered currents

name: P_cu_ref
description: copper loss at the requested current: 1.5 R (id*^2 + iq*^2)

name: dP_cu
description: copper-loss mismatch: P_cu minus P_cu_ref

name: dP_elec_ref
description: M6c: delivered electrical power minus reference-implied electrical power = dP_mech + dP_cu + P_mag (exact)

name: E_elec_ref_unserved
description: M8c: cumulative electrical energy the reference implied and the motor did not receive

name: E_mag_store
description: magnetic energy stored in the windings since t=0 (integral of P_mag; bounded, so it does not drift)

name: resid_elec_decomp
description: dP_elec_ref - (dP_mech + dP_cu + P_mag): decomposition check, should be ~0

name: P_that
description: shaft power the voltage command assumes: estimated torque (uses psi_hat) times w_m

name: P_psi_err
description: power mismatch caused by the flux-estimate error: -1.5 w_el psi_tilde i_q

name: P_fb
description: feedback-correction power inside the voltage command: P_req_elec - P_cu - P_that

name: resid_req_decomp
description: dP_elec - (P_psi_err + P_mag - P_fb): decomposition of the voltage-command mismatch, should be ~0

name: resid_du_power
description: dP_elec - 1.5 (du_d i_d + du_q i_q): actuator-mismatch identity, should be ~0

name: req_sign_conflict
description: flag: voltage-command power and reference-implied power disagree in sign (counterfactual warning)

name: T_roll
description: rolling-resistance torque on the shaft (constant term of the load, follows the sign of speed)

name: T_visc
description: viscous / drivetrain friction torque b * w_m

name: T_aero
description: aerodynamic drag torque c * w_m * |w_m|

name: T_req_data
description: shaft torque the speed request needs, from the cycle and vehicle equations (no controller involved)

name: T_avail
description: most torque the motor can hold at this speed with the nominal ceiling and the current limit

name: data_ratio
description: |T_req_data| / T_avail. Above 1 the request is infeasible for ANY controller

name: data_infeasible
description: flag: data_ratio above 1. Mismatch at these instants is attributable to the data, not the controller

name: psi_hat
description: adaptive flux estimate

name: psi_tilde
description: estimation error

name: e_q
description: q current tracking error

name: e_qa
description: anti-windup compensated error

name: z
description: anti-windup auxiliary state

name: i_lim_eff
description: current limit in force (governor)

name: V
description: candidate Lyapunov function V_e + V_theta + V_aw

name: meas_i_a
description: phase-a current as measured: gain/offset/noise/12-bit quantization/clip

name: meas_i_b
description: phase-b current as measured

name: meas_i_c
description: phase-c current as measured

name: meas_i_d
description: d current the controller sees (Park of measured phases at the measured angle)

name: meas_i_q
description: q current the controller sees

name: meas_theta
description: resolver electrical angle as measured (offset, noise, ripple)

name: meas_omega
description: mechanical speed as estimated by the PLL from the measured angle

name: meas_vdc
description: DC-bus voltage as measured (divider gain error, noise, first-order low-pass)

name: gap_i_a
description: measured minus true phase-a current

name: gap_i_b
description: measured minus true phase-b current

name: gap_i_c
description: measured minus true phase-c current

name: gap_i_d
description: measured minus true d current

name: gap_i_q
description: measured minus true q current

name: gap_theta
description: measured minus true electrical angle

name: gap_omega
description: estimated minus true mechanical speed

name: gap_vdc
description: measured minus true DC-bus voltage

name: bms_i_dis_lim
description: BMS discharge-current limit as sent (latency, 1 A quantization, multiplicative error)

name: bms_i_chg_lim
description: BMS charge-current limit as sent

name: bms_v_pack
description: pack voltage reported by the BMS (delayed)

name: bms_age_s
description: age of the BMS message when used

name: belief_R
description: stator resistance the controller believes (constant per run, drawn from the belief-error range)

name: belief_Ld
description: d inductance the controller believes

name: belief_Lq
description: q inductance the controller believes

name: belief_J
description: inertia the controller believes

name: belief_psi_name
description: nameplate flux the controller uses for Kt and the governor (not the adaptive estimate)

name: ceiling_hat
description: voltage ceiling the controller believes, min(vdc_m/sqrt(3), 173.2) (or the labelled oracle)

name: du_q_known
description: q-voltage change from the controller's own clip, the saturation it knows about

name: theta_adv
description: angle advance applied to the command to offset the computation delay

name: u_d_ctrl
description: d command before the controller's own clip (controller frame)

name: u_q_ctrl
description: q command before the controller's own clip

name: u_d_clip
description: d command after the controller's own clip

name: u_q_clip
description: q command after the controller's own clip

name: u_d_plant
description: d voltage reported by the plant model

name: u_q_plant
description: q voltage reported by the plant model

name: u_d_extra
description: inverter dead-time/device-drop error added after the plant clip, d axis

name: u_q_extra
description: inverter dead-time/device-drop error, q axis

name: d_u_ctrl_clip_d
description: ledger piece 1: controller's own clip (known saturation), d

name: d_u_ctrl_clip_q
description: ledger piece 1: controller's own clip, q

name: d_u_adv_d
description: ledger piece 2: angle advance rotation, d

name: d_u_adv_q
description: ledger piece 2: angle advance rotation, q

name: d_u_delay_d
description: ledger piece 3: computation delay (delayed command minus current command), d

name: d_u_delay_q
description: ledger piece 3: computation delay, q

name: d_u_rot_d
description: ledger piece 4: rotation by the angle error, d

name: d_u_rot_q
description: ledger piece 4: rotation by the angle error, q

name: d_u_plant_clip_d
description: ledger piece 5: plant clip against the TRUE ceiling (hidden saturation), d

name: d_u_plant_clip_q
description: ledger piece 5: plant clip against the true ceiling, q

name: d_u_inv_d
description: ledger piece 6: inverter dead-time/device-drop error, d

name: d_u_inv_q
description: ledger piece 6: inverter error, q

name: sat_ctrl
description: flag: the controller's own command exceeded the ceiling it believes

name: sat_plant
description: flag: the plant clipped the command against the true ceiling

name: V_e
description: Lyapunov term 0.5 Lq e_a^2 (current-error energy)

name: V_theta
description: Lyapunov term psi_tilde^2 / (2 Gamma) (parameter-error energy; uses TRUE flux, truth column)

name: V_aw
description: Lyapunov term 0.5 Lq z^2 (anti-windup auxiliary state)

name: v_ref_mps
description: cycle speed request in vehicle units (cycle runs only)
